cleaner.label: Compiler caches (ccache and sccache)
cleaner.description: Cache of objects compiled by ccache and sccache, rebuildable. Does not touch ccache settings.

option.label: ccache cache
option.description: Removes the compiled objects saved by ccache. The ccache.conf settings file stays.

option.label: sccache cache
option.description: Removes the compiled objects sccache saved on disk.
option.warning: Stop the sccache server (`sccache --stop-server`) before cleaning. Later builds will be slower until the cache fills up.
